title: Apple unveils Siri AI built on a Gemini-collaborated Apple Foundation Model at WWDC 2026
summary: At WWDC 2026, Apple introduced Siri AI, a fully rebuilt assistant backed by next-generation Apple Foundation Models developed in collaboration with Google, available to developers in iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27 and visionOS 27 betas, and rolling out to users later this year.

title: Apple opens its Foundation Models framework with a new on-device model, server mode, and tool calling
summary: Apple's Foundation Models framework gains a stronger on-device model, server-side Private Cloud Compute access via PrivateCloudComputeLanguageModel, a new Dynamic Profiles primitive for agentic experiences, built-in tools like BarcodeReaderTool and OCRTool, and an open-source utilities package, shipping in iOS 27 / macOS 27.

title: Alibaba debuts Qwen3.7-Max flagship with 1M-token context and a 35-hour autonomous task run
summary: At the Apsara Summit in Hangzhou on May 20, Alibaba unveiled Qwen3.7-Max as its next agent-era flagship, with a 1M-token context window, deep-reasoning and tool-invocation upgrades, and an internal demo in which the model autonomously completed 1,000+ tool calls over 35 hours to optimize a kernel on Alibaba's new Zhenwu M890 chip.

title: Stability AI releases Stable Audio 3.0 with 6-minute tracks and open weights for small and medium variants
summary: Stability AI's Stable Audio 3.0 family ships four models trained on fully licensed data: Small SFX and Small (459M params) for on-device 2-minute audio, Medium (1.4B) for full 6:20 compositions on consumer hardware, and a 2.7B Large model reserved for API and enterprise customers, with three of the four released under open weights.

title: Adobe ships a productivity agent for Acrobat and PDF Spaces in Acrobat Express and Studio
summary: Adobe unveiled an agentic productivity agent that chats with PDFs, generates presentations, podcasts, blogs, and social posts from documents, and powers new PDF Spaces sharing and publishing capabilities inside Acrobat; the agent is included with the new Acrobat Express tier and Acrobat Studio.

title: Anthropic ships Claude Opus 4.8 with Dynamic Workflows and effort control for Claude Code
summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, pricing held at $5/$25 per million input/output tokens, alongside Dynamic Workflows in Claude Code that orchestrate hundreds of parallel subagents for codebase-scale migrations, an effort-control slider on claude.ai and Cowork, and fast mode now 3x cheaper than for previous models.

title: Anthropic raises $65B Series H at $965B post-money valuation as run-rate tops $47B
summary: Anthropic closed a $65B Series H led by Altimeter, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia at a $965B post-money valuation, disclosing a $47B annualized revenue run-rate and fresh compute deals with Amazon, Google, Broadcom, and SpaceX that make Claude the first frontier model on AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.

title: Google launches Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini Omni, and the agentic Gemini app at I/O 2026
summary: Google rolled out Gemini 3.5 Flash as the new default for the Gemini app and AI Mode, launched Gemini Omni Flash for video generation across Gemini app, Flow, and YouTube Shorts, and introduced Gemini Spark, a 24/7 personal agent, alongside Managed Agents in the Gemini API and the Antigravity preview agent.

title: Google DeepMind ships Co-Scientist, a multi-agent AI research partner, in Nature
summary: DeepMind published the Co-Scientist multi-agent system in Nature and began rolling out Hypothesis Generation, an experimental tool that lets individual researchers leverage the system to generate, debate, and evolve novel hypotheses, with broader enterprise access through Gemini for Science.

title: Microsoft ships seven in-house MAI models led by MAI-Thinking-1 at Build 2026
summary: Mustafa Suleyman unveiled seven first-party Microsoft AI models at Build 2026: MAI-Image-2.5 and Flash, MAI-Transcribe-1.5, MAI-Voice-2 and Flash, MAI-Thinking-1 (a reasoning model that matches Opus 4.6 on SWE-Bench Pro), and MAI-Code-1-Flash, the 5B coding model now rolling out as the default in VS Code GitHub Copilot and Foundry in private preview.

title: Microsoft unveils Majorana 2 quantum chip with 1,000x reliability boost and 2029 scalable target
summary: Microsoft's Majorana 2 topological quantum chip reaches a mean qubit parity lifetime of 20 seconds (some over a minute) by swapping aluminum for a lead superconductor, accelerating the company's roadmap to a scalable quantum computer to 2029 and shipping Microsoft Discovery as a generally available agentic research platform.

title: Mistral ships Mistral Large 3 (675B MoE), Medium 3.5, and Ministral 3 under Apache 2.0
summary: At its first AI Now Summit, Mistral released Mistral Large 3 (a 675B-parameter MoE with 41B active trained on 3,000 NVIDIA H200s), the 128B dense Medium 3.5 that hits 77.6% on SWE-Bench Verified and powers remote coding agents and Work mode in Le Chat, and three Ministral 3 sizes (3B, 8B, 14B), all under Apache 2.0.

title: Mistral launches Mistral for Industrial Engineering with Airbus, BMW, and EDF as launch customers
summary: Built around Mistral's acquisition of Vienna-based Emmi AI, Mistral for Industrial Engineering packages physics-aware AI for simulation, design, and asset optimization in heavy industry, naming Airbus, BMW, EDF, and CMA CGM as initial deployments alongside partners ASML, Safran, and Siemens Energy.

title: MiniMax launches M3, the first open-weight model with 1M context, multimodality, and frontier coding
summary: MiniMax's M3 ships with the new MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA) architecture to support a 1M-token context window, native image and video input, and computer use; it scores 59.0% on SWE-Bench Pro and 70.06% on OSWorld-Verified, with a $20/month Token Plan, discounted launch API pricing, and open weights due within 10 days.

title: NVIDIA launches Cosmos 3, the first fully open omnimodel for physical AI
summary: Unveiled at GTC Taipei, NVIDIA's Cosmos 3 is the first fully open mixture-of-transformers omnimodel that reasons and generates across text, images, video, ambient sound, and action for robotics and AV training; Super and Nano variants are available now on build.nvidia.com and Hugging Face under the OpenMDW 1.1 license, with Cosmos Coalition partners including Black Forest Labs, Runway, and Skild AI.

title: NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super brings 32B-parameter reasoning VLA to level-4 robotaxi development
summary: NVIDIA introduced Alpamayo 2 Super, a 32B open reasoning vision-language-action model that scales 3x over the 10B Alpamayo family and adds full-surround perception plus Meta-Actions for yielding, lane changes, and stops; inference code and weights land on GitHub and Hugging Face this summer, alongside AlpaGym, OmniDreams, and Omniverse NuRec.

title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B MoE for long-running agents with Perplexity, Palantir, and ServiceNow
summary: Announced at GTC Taipei, Nemotron 3 Ultra is a 550B MoE with 55B active parameters and hybrid Mamba-Transformer layers that delivers up to 5x faster inference and 30% lower cost-to-completion on agentic benchmarks; CrowdStrike and Palantir are early adopters, and the model is open under the Nemotron Coalition.

title: OpenAI opens Rosalind Biodefense to vetted U.S. developers and government partners
summary: OpenAI launched the Rosalind Biodefense program, expanding trusted access to its life-sciences model GPT-Rosalind for vetted U.S. developers, public-health agencies, and biodefense partners, with a controlled-access deployment model rather than an open commercial release.

title: OpenAI ships GPT-Realtime-2, GPT-Realtime-Translate, and GPT-Realtime-Whisper in the Realtime API
summary: OpenAI introduced three audio models in the Realtime API: GPT-Realtime-2 brings GPT-5-class reasoning to voice agents, GPT-Realtime-Translate supports 70+ input languages translated live to 13 output languages, and GPT-Realtime-Whisper streams low-latency speech-to-text for captions, meeting notes, and live voice products.

title: xAI launches Grok Build, a terminal coding agent for SuperGrok and X Premium+ subscribers
summary: xAI introduced Grok Build, an early-beta coding agent and CLI for professional software engineering with full ACP support, headless `-p` mode for scripts, and workflow orchestration; it's free for SuperGrok and X Premium+ subscribers, and powers the new grok-build-0.1 model now on the xAI API at $1/$2 per million input/output tokens.

title: xAI adds Custom Voices for sub-two-minute voice cloning and 80+ presets in 28 languages
summary: xAI launched Custom Voices and the Voice Library on the Grok Voice API, letting users clone a voice from about a minute of natural speech in under two minutes through a two-stage verification pipeline (live passphrase plus speaker-embedding match), and expanding the built-in voice catalog to over 80 voices across 28 languages at no extra TTS or Voice Agent charge.

title: Perplexity Computer lands inside Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
summary: Perplexity extended its Computer digital worker into Microsoft 365 apps, where it can read email in Outlook, pull data from Excel, draft documents in Word, and assemble PowerPoint decks through a single coordinated session; the integration is available now on Microsoft Marketplace for Pro, Max, Enterprise Pro, and Enterprise Max customers.

title: ByteDance rolls out paid Doubao subscriptions in China with 68 to 500 yuan tiers
summary: ByteDance became the first major Chinese AI vendor to break the all-free consensus, launching three paid Doubao tiers (68, 200, and 500 yuan per month) targeting PowerPoint generation, data analysis, and video production while keeping a free basic version; monthly active users reached about 345M ahead of a planned June Force Conference rollout.

title: Zhipu launches GLM-5.1-HighSpeed API with a 400 tokens/s global speed record
summary: Zhipu rolled out GLM-5.1-HighSpeed to select enterprise customers on its MaaS platform, hitting a sustained 400 tokens/s output via the TileRT inference engine that statically compiles the model into a persistent GPU kernel; the model is also listed in Alibaba Cloud's DashScope catalog alongside Qwen, DeepSeek, and Kimi.
